hr.page_title: NimbusIT | Web dizajn i digitalni marketing
hr.page_description: Web dizajn, SEO, Google i Meta oglasi te razvoj po mjeri. Izravna suradnja s Antoniom Lovrićem za obrte i tvrtke u Hrvatskoj i EU.
hr.hero_intro: Web dizajn i digitalni marketing za poduzetnike koji imaju što ponuditi. Pokažimo to budućim klijentima.
hr.city_intro: Netko vas pronađe na Googleu, netko klikne na oglas. Web im treba pomoći da upoznaju ponudu i jave vam se.
hr.services_intro: Predstavljanje poslovanja, oglašavanje i alati koji olakšavaju prodaju. Biramo ono što vam treba sada i ostavljamo prostor za dalje.
hr.pricing_intro: Početne cijene za tri vrste projekta. Točnu ponudu, rok i sadržaj dogovaramo prije početka.
hr.monthly_intro: Održavanje, sadržaj i kampanje mogu se nastaviti kroz mjesečni dogovor.
hr.cost_intro: Jedan web, jedan jezik i dva kruga izmjena. Mjesečno vođenje, oglasni budžet, hosting, domena, licence i vanjski alati plaćaju se zasebno.
hr.cost_details_1: Strategija uključuje plan i preporuke. Izrada i postavljanje kampanja ugovaraju se zasebno.
hr.cost_details_2: Paket Web ne uključuje postavljanje oglasa ni CRM integracije. Ostali paketi uključuju početno postavljanje jednog oglasnog kanala, do navedenih granica.
hr.cost_details_3: Dodatne stranice, novi tekstovi, složeniji izračuni i dodatna povezivanja dogovaraju se u ponudi. Konfigurator i CRM zajedno zaseban su opseg. Budžet za oglase plaćate izravno Googleu ili Meti.
hr.project_intro: Kupac želi usporediti modele i vidjeti kako pergola izgleda u stvarnom prostoru.
hr.project_body: Galerije prikazuju izvedene radove, a konfigurator prikuplja model, dimenzije i opremu. Odabrani detalji i lokacija stižu uz upit za ponudu.
hr.project_done: Stranice proizvoda, galerije, konfigurator, uređene fotografije i osnovni SEO.
hr.project_next: Google kampanje, provjera mjerenja i završne dorade. Rezultata kampanja još nema.
hr.process_intro: Prvo upoznam vaš posao. Zatim dogovorimo što radimo i prolazimo izradu korak po korak.
hr.about_intro: Vodim NimbusIT i surađujem s poduzetnicima iz Hrvatske i EU.
hr.about_body: Od prve ideje do objave imate jednu osobu za dogovor: mene. Proći ćemo ponudu, pregledati radnu verziju i doraditi ono što treba prije objave.
hr.contact_intro: Opišite što planirate. Ako već imate web, možemo krenuti od besplatne analize.
hr.analysis_note: 15 minuta razgovora i pet preporuka u PDF-u. Besplatno i bez obveze.
hr.project_image_alt: Izvedena bioklimatska pergola uz bazen, iz projekta s konfiguratorom

en.page_title: NimbusIT | Web design and digital marketing
en.page_description: Websites, SEO, Google and Meta ads, configurators and CRM connections. Work directly with Antonio Lovrić in Croatia and the EU.
en.hero_intro: Web design and digital marketing for independent businesses with something to offer. Let’s put it in front of your next customers.
en.city_intro: Some people find you on Google. Others click an ad. Your website should help them understand the offer and get in touch.
en.services_intro: A clear offer, the right channels and tools that make sales easier. We choose what you need now and leave room to develop it.
en.pricing_eyebrow: Agree the scope before we start
en.pricing_intro: Starting prices for three types of project. You receive the full scope, price and schedule before work begins.
en.monthly_intro: Care, content and campaigns can continue under a separate monthly agreement.
en.cost_intro: One website, one language and two rounds of revisions. Monthly management, ad spend, hosting, domain, licences and external tools are separate costs.
en.cost_details_1: Strategy covers a plan and recommendations. Website builds and campaign setup are separate.
en.cost_details_2: Website & enquiries does not include ad setup or CRM integrations. The other packages include initial setup of one ad channel within the stated limits.
en.cost_details_3: Extra pages, new copy, complex calculations and additional connections are quoted separately. A configurator and CRM together need a separate scope. Ad spend is paid directly to Google or Meta.
en.project_intro: Buyers want to compare models and see how a pergola looks in a real space.
en.project_body: Project galleries show the finished installations. The configurator collects the model, dimensions and options. Those details and the location travel with the request for a quote.
en.project_done: Product pages, galleries, configurator, edited photographs and basic SEO preparation.
en.project_next: Google campaigns, measurement checks and final improvements. Campaign results are not yet available.
en.process_eyebrow: From the first message to launch
en.process_intro: First I get to know your business. Then we agree the work and review it together, one step at a time.
en.about_intro: I run NimbusIT and work with independent businesses in Croatia and the EU.
en.about_body: From the first idea to launch, you have one person to talk to: me. We’ll agree the offer, review the working version and make the changes before it goes live.
en.contact_intro: Tell me what you’re planning. If you already have a website, we can start with a free review.
en.contact_bar: A few details to get started
en.analysis_note: A 15-minute conversation and five recommendations in a PDF. Free, with no obligation.
en.project_image_alt: An installed bioclimatic pergola beside a pool, from the configurator project

services.title: A proper introduction.
services.body: Customers want to understand the offer, see your work and decide whether you’re a good fit. Design and content should make that easy.

services.title: Keep the conversation going.
